_comment: models.<key> = {tag, quantization, digest}; primary names the one the app uses. `sib start` refuses to start while models.<primary>.tag is missing, unless SIB_FAKE_MODEL=1 is set (recorded fixtures, for tests, CI and `npm run dev` only). With the tag set but no Ollama answering on 127.0.0.1, the app starts and Gemma shows offline (rule odds, settlements wait). gemma.toolUse: native | injected (the T-001 fallback: the app fetches the forecast and passes it as the tool result). gemma.answerMode: single_call | two_step. models.e4b-ft (optional, same shape): the fine-tuned bookmaker, used only while the finetunedBookmaker flag is on. llamaCpp: the llama.cpp server that hears the voice notes (flag `voice`), 127.0.0.1 only.
